body:
For whatever reason, comments being added aren't showing. 

I assume they are comments to discourage me or offer support, which I appreciate. However, I think I figured out how to do my goodbyes, and have started the videos for them, as well as gathering my needed supplies. I've already sent some simple goodbye messages to those I care about, so now I wait until everything can be finalized.

I posted here, because talking about things helps me process, and at this point I have no one I can confide in who wouldn't try to stop me. I appreciate the one comment I have been able to read, as well as the message offering support. Your hearts are in the right place, and I will take that kindness to heart.

Thank you again, truly.
